Additional-income tax and health calculation

Reviewed monthly cash settlement from historical social premiums and dated tax/health parameters, before native payroll integration.

Version19.0.1.0.2
EditionCommunity and Enterprise
LicenceAGPL-3
Requiresl10n_sk_hr_payroll_income_allocation, l10n_sk_hr_payroll_oca

Purpose

Calculate reviewed positive cash remuneration after termination. Social premiums come from the historical register; health and income tax use the reviewed reporting month and native dated parameters. Other monthly payments are consolidated before applying tax bands/NČZD. The one-day 2Y health profile supports minimum top-ups and refund of a previous monthly top-up.

Editable form fields and optional hidden API facts cannot be mixed. Evidence, source/parameter digests, archived calculations, retries and reset dependencies are checked. The calculation stores amounts, not an accounting entry.

Limits

Monthly cash settlement paid in the next month of the same year, insurance ended before that reporting month, only one 2Y health day; no child bonus, other benefits/deductions or exceptional corrections. Health profiles and tax pension status are separate reviewed facts. Native slip/accounting integration belongs to the separate native payroll bridge; historical VPP/health exports remain separate.

Legal basis

Monthly tax consolidation follows § 35, declaration facts § 36, and cent rounding § 47. The pension status at 1 January under §11(6) does not grant a monthly allowance merely because the declaration checkbox is selected. Finančná správa's 2026 NČZD FAQ, questions 7 and 9 explicitly excludes monthly NČZD for that pension profile, including a small pension; the difference after annual pension including the 13th pension belongs to annual reconciliation/personal return. A pension first effective later in the year is a different tax fact. The 2027 §35 wording retains that distinction.

Health scope/exclusions follow § 10b and §11(3), rates and monthly advances § 16, and the day-proportional minimum, its exceptions and additional employee advance § 16a. The 2Y code and last-day, single-day registration follow insurer methodology, not a literal code in the statute: Union instructions. If an earlier payment of the same month already charged a minimum top-up, the new calculation pays only the difference from the consolidated monthly amount; a negative difference returns the earlier excess. It is not an annual-insurer refund or permission to refund an unrelated period's contribution.
